story_type: soldiers jump from a helicopter ramp into the ocean
hook: They stepped off the back of a flying helicopter, into the sea.
narration: They stepped off the back of a flying helicopter, straight into the sea.
This is a helocast, off Hawaii in July 2022, during the world's largest maritime exercise.
Australian soldiers rode out in a Marine CH-53E Super Stallion.
For a helocast, the pilot flies low and slow, often about ten feet up and ten knots.
The ramp stays open, and the soldiers wait on the edge for the signal.
Below them, the rotor wash whips the water white.
outcome: One by one, they dropped off the ramp and hit the water feet first.
